Let \(m(x)=\frac{P(x)}{30}=x^3-\frac53x^2+\frac{11}{15}x-\frac1{30}\). Then

\[
(1-r_1)(1-r_2)(1-r_3)=m(1)=1-\frac53+\frac{11}{15}-\frac1{30}=\frac1{30}.
\]

The numerator of \(\sum_i \frac1{1-r_i}\) is

\[
3-2\cdot\frac53+\frac{11}{15}=\frac25.
\]

Thus

\[
\sum_{n=0}^\infty s_n=\sum_{i=1}^3 \frac1{1-r_i}
=\frac{\frac25}{\frac1{30}}=12.
\]

\[
\boxed{12}
\]
